$description: The fixed list both renderers draw, to compare by eye. A specimen's id is a Storybook story path (title/story name, as sokkel-ui's sidebar shows it); the egui storybook has a story at the same path, so the two pair by name with no mapping. Both capture the story's canvas only, never the storybook's chrome.
slug: The id in lower case with every / and space turned into _, as sokkel-ui-egui's snapshot test names its files today.

steps.hover: The pointer rests over the target's center. Web: locator.hover(). egui_kittest: the node's hover().
steps.press: The pointer is down on the target and held. Web: mouse.down() over it. egui: a pointer-down event held across the captured frame.
steps.click: A press and release on the target. Web: locator.click(). egui_kittest: the node's click(), then frames until it settles.
steps.keyFocus: The target gets keyboard focus. Web: Tab until it is focused, so :focus-visible matches. egui: Tab key events until the node has focus, so the last input kind is the keyboard.
steps.key: A key pressed while the focus is where the last step left it.
steps.resize: The canvas is this wide for the capture.

targets: A target is a role and a name, as a screen reader would find it: button:Run now, textbox:Job name, row:2, table. Playwright's getByRole and egui_kittest's AccessKit queries both find it.
content: An existing story's content is what sokkel-ui's story draws (its data and its doc comment); the egui story at the same path draws the same. A story marked new does not exist yet: sokkel-ui adds it under the real title, from the fixtures here.

field.label: Job name
field.error: A job named nightly-export already exists.
field.errorDetail: Job names are unique within harbor.
field.warning: Names over 24 characters are cut short in the rail.

specimens.shows: Rows xs, sm, default, lg; columns label, icon and label, icon at the end, icon only (as an icon button of that row's size). fixtures.button.

also.why: Below 768 every size but xs is a finger tall.

specimens.steps: Each `<step>-<variant>` does that step on the first button of that variant: hover, keyFocus or press.
specimens.shows: The interaction states, one capture each.
A reasoned button with keyboard focus: the focus ring and the reason in its tooltip.
Empty with its placeholder, disabled, read only, a warning. fixtures.field.
An invalid field with its popover open (issueOpen): the error, its detail and its action. fixtures.field.
Hover (no look of its own today) and focus.
invalid+focus: the critical edge and the 3px ring, which shows only with focus.
500 runs sorted by duration, longest first.
Three runs selected and the selection bar.
A list below its stack width (64rem of its own box): every row a card.
A search that matches nothing: the heads and the words.
A refused read said in a table's place: the heading, the diagnostic, the problems, Try again.
The pointer over the second row; keyboard focus on the table with the third row active.
The whole frame: rail, top bar with its search and trail, page, foot.
The frame at 390: the menu button, the last crumb, the palette as an icon.

also.why: Below 768 the dialog fills the screen and opens on its list.

specimens.shows: The settings dialog over the page.
